text: “Why are you so dry, Catherine?” Mrs. Penniman said at last. “So dry?” “So cold—so irresponsive.” The girl turned very quickly. “Did he say that?” Mrs. Penniman hesitated a moment. “I will tell you what he said. He said he feared only one thing—that you would be afraid.” “Afraid of what?” “Afraid of your father.” Catherine turned back to the fire again, and then, after a pause, she said—“I am afraid of my father.” Mrs. Penniman got quickly up from her chair and approached her niece.
